qol: Shows crop growth/maturity, comparator mode, repeater delay, power level, villager profession and similar vanilla details
Optional mod name on item tooltips
Configurable position, scale, theme, opacity, display mode (toggle, hold or lite) and boss bar overlap handling
Selectable profiles and text-to-speech narration of the target
commands_and_keybinds: Show Details and profile-switch keys also exist (defaults not verified)
getting_started: Look at any block or mob; the tooltip appears at the top of the screen. Open the config with keypad 0 or via Mod Menu to change layout.
editor_notes: Default keys are numpad keys; laptop players may need to rebind. Recipe/uses keys are documented for JEI; REI integration unverified.
name: Jade
summary: An on-screen tooltip showing what block or entity you are looking at: name, source mod, crop growth, redstone state, villager profession and more. Works with only the client installed, but many details (item storage, brewing stand fuel, bees in hives) need it on the server too.
